name: use-interval
title: useInterval
description: Calls a function on a timer, with a null delay to pause it. Cleared on unmount.
a11y: No DOM output. Clears its timer on unmount so nothing runs after the component is gone.
Pass null as the delay to pause.

props.name: callback
props.description: Runs on every tick. The latest version is used.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds between ticks, or `null` to pause.
